description: An iron furnace construct animated by one large vertical eye made of fire and darkness. It transforms from a round little brazier into a barrel-chested furnace warden and an angular forge sentinel.
A sandstone and living-wood giant with an elephant head, a moss-covered trunk, bark-textured tusks, enormous hands and terraced bonsai trees growing across its back.
A slate-blue storm giant with a ram head, curling horns, a white cloud mane and beard, digitigrade legs and cloven hooves, bronze bracers and electric-blue lightning accents.

A hunchbacked stone giant with four long bulky arms and red lacquer armor edged in antique gold. A rough boulder juvenile becomes an arch-backed guardian and a broad ancient titan with a ridged natural stone mantle; never architectural shoulders.
An undead slate giant with greatly elongated arms and ground-reaching knuckles, weathered burial wraps, a shadowed stone mask, cyan-glowing exposed ribs and a tombstone mantle.

A hopping ancestral undead faerie with a pale spectral moth head, luminous compound eyes, feathery antennae, exactly two ectoplasmic tendril arms emerging from silk sleeves, moth wings and warm antique lantern ornaments.
